title: RFID & NFC Buyer FAQ — Questions Before Ordering
summary: Most first-email questions can be answered before they are asked. This FAQ covers the chip, compliance, MOQ, lead time, sample, packaging, encoding and reorder questions buyers ask most often. If your question is not here, the contact paths below collect the right context for a faster engineering reply.
heroPoints: Read this before sending the first email: most generic questions are answered here.
FAQ entries link to deeper guides, comparison pages and product hubs for follow-up reading.
Anything not covered here is best taken to the industry-specific contact path or WhatsApp.

brief.label: Faster paths if your question is specific

sections.title: Sampling, lead time and MOQ
sections.intro: These are the questions buyers ask most often when first scoping a program. Numbers below are typical for stocked chip families with no custom housing or printing.
bullets: Standard MOQ: 500 pieces for cards, 1,000 pieces for tags or labels, 100 pieces for keyfobs and wristbands.
Sample turnaround: 5–7 working days for stocked chip families; +3–5 days for custom housings or printing.
Sample policy: free samples of stock SKUs in low quantities; paid samples when chip programming, anti-metal lamination or custom printing is involved.
First-PO lead time: 12–18 working days from artwork approval; rush options available on request.
Reorder lead time: 10–14 working days once spec is locked.

sections.title: Chip families and reader compatibility
sections.intro: We hold stock of the chip families that drive 95% of B2B RFID and NFC inquiries. Less common chips are usually sourceable with longer lead times.
bullets: HF/NFC stocks: NTAG 213/215/216/424 DNA, MIFARE Classic 1k/4k, MIFARE Plus EV2, MIFARE DESFire EV2/EV3, MIFARE Ultralight C/EV1, ICODE SLIX, EM4100/4200/4305.
UHF stocks: Impinj Monza M730/M750/M770/M800, {chip:alien-higgs-3:name}/4/EC/9, {chip:nxp-ucode-7:name}/8/9.
Reader compatibility: hotel locks (Saflok, VingCard, Onity, Salto, Hafele Dialock, Be-Tech, MIWA), NXP/ACS/Identiv/uTrust readers, Impinj/Zebra UHF readers.
Encoding workflows: UID lock, NDEF write, GS1 SGTIN-96, custom block-level writes.
Sample requests routinely include reader/host firmware version so we can validate before shipping.

sections.title: Encoding, numbering and marking
sections.intro: Most B2B programs require chip-level customization. We do encoding and marking in-house.
bullets: Encoding: UID lock, NDEF (URI, text, vCard, MIME type), GS1 SGTIN-96 EPC, custom block writes.
Numbering: laser-engraved sequential numbers, embossed UID, QR code and barcode integration.
Marking: laser engraving, hot stamping, 4-color offset, UV printing, screen printing.
Per-piece UID export: CSV file with UID-to-serial mapping shipped with every encoded order.
Encoding QC: 100% functional read test on every encoded SKU.

sections.title: Compliance, certification and documentation
sections.intro: Every shipment includes the standard compliance declarations. Specific test reports can be commissioned for certification audits.
bullets: Standards: ISO/IEC 14443-3 (HF/NFC), ISO/IEC 15693 (vicinity), ISO/IEC 18000-6C (UHF).
Materials: RoHS, REACH SVHC, California Prop 65 declarations on file per chip family.
Radio: FCC Part 15/18, CE EN 300 330, MIC (Japan), CCC (China).

Quality system: ISO 9001:2015, certificate 98026Q00274R000, valid to 09 Jun 2029 — scope is the sales service of smart cards and RFID tags; see /about/certifications/ for the full scope and registrar lookup.
EU compliance: Digital Product Passport / Battery Regulation 2023/1542 technical-file support.
Test reports: TÜV, SGS, Intertek commissionable per program.

sections.title: Shipping, packaging and reorder
sections.intro: Logistics handling is part of the deliverable. We ship globally with documentation included.
bullets: Shipping options: DHL, FedEx, EMS for air; sea freight (FOB Shenzhen / Yantian) for bulk.
Documentation: commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, RoHS / REACH declarations, encoding CSV when applicable.
Packaging defaults: bulk poly bag, 100 / 200 / 500 per inner; custom sleeve, blister or branded box on request.
Lead-time control: we hold 30 days of safety stock on top-running chip families to absorb reorder spikes.
Returns: defective lots are replaced under our 12-month functional warranty (per shipment QC certificate).

faq.question: Where do I send a first inquiry?
faq.answer: Use /contact/ to pick the industry path that matches your project, or message +86 186 6582 0632 on WhatsApp for a quick chat. Email info@proudtek.com works for sample briefs with attached spec sheets.

faq.question: Do you accept paid samples?
faq.answer: Yes. Paid samples are typical when chip programming, anti-metal lamination or custom printing is involved. Sample fees are credited against the first PO if the program proceeds.

faq.question: What is your warranty policy?
faq.answer: We provide a 12-month functional warranty against chip failure or encoding defect. Defective lots are replaced after diagnostic verification. Mechanical wear, water damage outside IP rating and unauthorized modification are not covered.

faq.question: Can you encode chips before shipping?
faq.answer: Yes. UID lock, NDEF programming and GS1 SGTIN-96 EPC encoding are all done in-house. We include a CSV file mapping UID to your serial reference with every encoded order.

faq.question: Do you ship to my country?
faq.answer: Almost certainly. We have shipped to multiple continents via DHL, FedEx and EMS for air, plus sea freight for bulk. The few exceptions involve countries with sanctioned trade restrictions; we will tell you up front if your destination is one.
